name: ak:agent-browser
overview: Browser and desktop automation through the agent-browser CLI. Use for long autonomous browsing, compact page snapshots, screenshots, form filling, login/test flows without real Chrome profile state, scraping, exploratory QA, cloud browsers, Electron apps, Slack automation, and bug hunts.
whenToUse: Invoke for browser/app automation that needs snapshots or clicks and does not require the user's real Chrome profile state.
